title: Google Upgrades AI Assistant CC: Supports Managing Up to 6 Family Members Collaboratively
summary: Google is testing a family-focused AI assistant, CC. The new version connects email, calendar, chat, and task management to coordinate family schedules, to-dos, shopping lists, and meal plans. The upgrade responds to users wanting AI help with kids' school events, sports, and bills. CC began as a personal productivity tool linking Gmail, Calendar, and Drive for daily summaries.....
